verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no local pre-commit hook mode for GitLab's scanners. The closest feature is server-side secret push protection, which blocks a push after the commit already exists in local history. That is a related but different control, and it covers secrets only, not other issues. CI/merge-request scanning (gitlab-docs-1, gitlab-docs-6) runs after code is committed, and IDE findings are a different surface again.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the scanner as a pre-commit hook so secrets and issues never enter my git history
